headline: Building AI automation systems and self-hosted infrastructure from Bandung, Indonesia.
valueProposition: An architect-operator hybrid who designs SOPs, pricing frameworks, and system architecture — while still debugging down to kernel and Docker internals. With a physics background and 5+ years in industrial IoT, now building AI automation systems and self-hosted infrastructure on a no-vendor-lock-in principle: clients fully own their systems.
bio: I'm M. Mifthahul Amien, CTO at PT Mesin Kantong Ajaib (Mantiq), based in Bandung, West Java, Indonesia. I'm also involved with AI Lab, Mantiq's sister R&D lab.

My path started in fundamental science: a Bachelor of Science in Physics from Universitas Negeri Gorontalo (State University of Gorontalo). From there I moved into industrial systems — 5+ years in industrial IoT, where sensors, devices, and physical processes have to talk to software. Today my focus sits in software: AI automation, and the infrastructure that runs it.
At Mantiq I lead the development of AI automation and infrastructure.
